searchText: are these two related? yes. you want somewhere to test your changes benchmarkoor isn't using glamsterdam-devnet-7 chain tho it's using the glamsterdam-devnet-7 code we could probably just swap over to glamsterdam-8 iamges for the benchmarkoor as there are no el diff between the two afaik there are gas param changes im all in for swapping, just would prefer if we dont kill the network until the swap happens which ones? I think they are exactly the same on 7 and 8 https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12083 How is that relevant to the devnet being up? just run a local kurtosis network if you need to test something? in the network you can re-execute all the blocks buddy it has a good sample of blocks great for performance work Can you replay against a node snapshot as well? So what I understand is you don't care that much about the difference between devnet-7 vs devnet-8 but you want to have a set of blocks to replay against to sanity check your changes? yes. and i would also rather not make my life more complicated with more "tools" and instead wait for a week until the benchmarking team is done with the swap.
